5232-5913-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5232-5913-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

34-141-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-6798.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2193-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

586-864-2279-3125-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2741-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2741-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1580-2292-3220-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2438-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
2438-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2438-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods

5702-5954-6664-7288.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1921-2034-7220.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Glamermite from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Glamermite token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2091-3277-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-3277-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3693-4616-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Walking Ballista from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2608-5168-5542-6797.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
2608-5168-5542-6797.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2608-5168-5542-6797.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
2608-5168-5542-6797.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

4050-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

790-1218-3862.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1218-3862.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Orcish Bowmasters infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

3140-6085-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
3140-6085-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

603-997-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-997-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1393-2292-4986-5034--18.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

191-1689-5636.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-5636.description:
Activate Psychic Frog's first ability by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

913-2440-3705-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
913-2440-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Living Hive trigger.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to an Insect token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

12-3266-4550-5289.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
12-3266-4550-5289.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Uprising trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1335-2265-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2265-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

1194-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: Knotvine Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
1194-2645-3430.description:
Activate Knotvine Mystic by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Knotvine Mystic.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

258-575-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
You control at least six lands.
258-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The face-down Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Tatyova, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental with haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

38-1298-3716-4280.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating eight 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 2 damage to any target and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Activate Skirk Prospector seven times by sacrificing seven Phyrexian Goblins, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

352-2196-3756.notablePrerequisites: At least two additional lands on the battlefield.
352-2196-3756.description:
Cast Frantic Search for {2}{U}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability targeting Frantic Search for {2}{U}{R}.
Resolve the copied Frantic Search to draw 2, discard two, and untap 3 lands you control, one of which should be Izzet Boilerworks.
Repeat for infinite looting.
